description:
On day 5 of each new month (configurable via a MONTH_END_SUMMARY_DAY env var, default 5), send a recap of the previous month: totals (income / spent / net), per-category spending vs limit, carry-over observations if we want them. Day 5 instead of day 1 gives SimpleFIN time to post late transactions (some banks lag 2-3 days on month-end postings).

Separate scheduled APScheduler job from the daily digest — add a new CronTrigger(day=MONTH_END_SUMMARY_DAY, hour=sync_hour_utc, minute=30). Reuse the HTML template infra from T-010. Could also include:
- Biggest category by spend
- Biggest surprise (largest overage vs limit)
- Fixed categories: list of ones that didn't post this month (bill missed?)
- Uncategorized transactions still outstanding

Blocked by T-010 (HTML template infra).
title: Month-end summary email
